FINDING 2026-08-28 (c), THE REAL BLOCKER - MODE MISMATCH. workflowMode is 'bugfix-fastlane', an implementation-bearing mode that requires implement, test, regression, simplify, stabilize, security and audit phases. This packet performed NONE of them and never claimed to: it wrote no product code, has no implementation files in its Change Boundary, and its executionHistory agents are bubbles.plan, bubbles.goal, bubbles.workflow and bubbles.validate. Its own bug.md describes it as a record that 'formalizes the four external-infrastructure gaps'. It is a TRIAGE UMBRELLA whose fixing was done by child packets, not a bugfix packet. Under bugfix-fastlane it can never be terminal, because seven of the phases it is required to have are phases it correctly did not run.
